name: components_user_defined_type
source:
{ A COMPONENT template that IS instantiated but whose ports are never
  connected: each free port becomes its own synthetic stream, so the
  network is well posed on its own. }
COMPONENT Divider(a, b)
  PARAM k
  b.sig = k * a.sig
END
Divider D1(s1, s2, k = 4)
s1.sig = 3
y = s2.sig
